scope: Read-only server diagnosis; changes and release verification performed outside the production server.

subsequent_client_failure_observed.message: no usable account for realm 'intl': all are disabled, cooling down, expired or parked by the daily token limit

findings: Upstream returned an actual request frequency rejection, code 14003. The HTTP account-soft-rate text was generated by the gateway.
The deployed default used 600-second exponential backoff for this request frequency error, with a 7200-second cap.
The deployed handler ignored Retry-After; replay with a seven-second hint cooled the account for 600 seconds.
A request already in flight could succeed after another request received 429 and erase its active cooldown.
Once the entire pool was parked, new calls changed from 429 to 503 without a retry delay.
Existing failure records do not retain upstream retry headers; the provider quota dimensions and exact frequency threshold cannot be established from these records.

reproduction.network: Synthetic upstream responses; no external generation calls.

release.note: Some platform-specific test cases are skipped on unsupported operating systems; all 113 suite files passed locally.
